title: AlphaPADI: Formulaic Alpha Discovery via Pool-Aware Hierarchical Discrete Diffusion
abstract: arXiv:2610.04959v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Formulaic alpha discovery seeks symbolic expressions that predict cross-sectional asset returns. In deployment, multiple formulas are combined into an alpha pool, where each formula is valued through the complementary information it contributes to joint predictive performance. While Reinforcement Learning and Generative Flow Networks have emerged as promising paradigms for generating formulaic alphas, existing frameworks face three related challenges. First, generating formulas individually leaves pool context and inter-formula complementarity outside the generative state. Second, formula-wise generation lacks a unified mechanism for preserving and revising structures at different levels. Third, pool-level rewards jointly reflect predictive performance and redundancy but cannot be differentiated directly through symbolic evaluation to train the generator. translated_title: AlphaPADI：基于池感知分层离散扩散的公式化Alpha发现
translated_abstract: 公式化Alpha发现旨在寻找能够预测横截面资产收益的符号表达式。在实际部署中，多个公式被组合成一个Alpha池，每个公式的价值通过其为联合预测性能所贡献的互补信息来衡量。虽然强化学习和生成流网络已成为生成公式化Alpha的有前景的范式，但现有框架面临三个相互关联的挑战。首先，逐个独立生成公式使得池上下文和公式间的互补性处于生成状态之外。其次，逐公式的生成方式缺乏一个统一的机制来保留和修改不同层次的结构。第三，池级别的奖励共同反映了预测性能和冗余性，但无法通过符号评估直接进行微分来训练生成器。为克服这些挑战，我们提出了AlphaPADI（公式化Alpha发现……）
tldr: 提出AlphaPADI框架，利用池感知的分层离散扩散模型进行公式化Alpha发现，在生成过程中融入Alpha池上下文与公式间互补性，统一实现多层次结构的保留与修改，并解决池级奖励难以直接微分训练生成器的难题。
en_tdlr: AlphaPADI proposes a pool-aware hierarchical discrete diffusion framework for formulaic alpha discovery that incorporates pool context and inter-formula complementarity into the generative process, unifies structure preservation and revision at multiple levels, and addresses the non-differentiable pool-level reward challenge.
